descriptions.notStarted: I better go talk to #bSakura#k, who's crying in front of the police station.
descriptions.inProgress: #bSakura#k wanted me to find the #bBoss Kitty#k that stole her Orange Marble, and retrieve it from it.
descriptions.completed: I will have to get the orange marble for #bSakura#k.  I am sure she is looking for it.  So what should be my next move? Perhaps confrontation...
